text:
Sara: quick sync — proposing a gated onboarding experiment for next week: 50 free credits + a small prompt-pack + an invite to a follow-up micro-webinar. target: new org signups in PLG funnel who hit the 'create-first-prompt' event.
Mateo: love it. what's the hypothesis? more activation from prompt templates or credits?
Sara: primary hypothesis = prompt templates reduce time-to-first-success and increase retention; credits help remove budget friction for trying larger prompts. expecting lift in day-7 DAU for the cohort.
Jen: can we microsegment by org size (1-10 vs 11-50) and by traffic source (product vs marketing)? routing to different webinar cohorts makes sense.
Vlad: routing note — make sure the inbound leads from webinar are tagged so sales doesn't get spammy. use hubspot property `redwood_onboard_cohort` + `credit_grant=true`.
Michelle: quick copy idea for the gated modal: "Get 50 free credits + a starter prompt pack — perfect for testing real use cases. Join our 30-min webinar to level up." short CTA: "Claim credits"
Jen: +1. Can we A/B test modal copy vs inline onboarding card? small n though.
Mateo: tracking: event names? propose `experiment:gated_onboard_v1:exposed` and `experiment:gated_onboard_v1:converted` and funnel tag `gated_onboard_v1` on user profile. ops team — ok to add? @OpsBot
OpsBot: noted. I can push the tracking events. Need the exact payload keys.
Vlad: hubspot mapping snippet for sales routing: ```json
{
  "property": "redwood_onboard_cohort",
  "values": {"cohort":"webinar-1","credits":"50","prompt_pack":"starter-v2"}
}
```
Michelle: who owns the prompt-pack? we should include 3 starter prompts: cold-email assist, product spec draft, and prompt for customer support triage. short descriptions for each.
Sara: @Mateo can you assemble prompt-pack and host as a downloadable JSON in /marketing/promptpacks/starter-v2.json? make it easy to paste into the playground.
Mateo: on it. will add copy and examples. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Jen: webinar logistics — 30 min + 10 min Q&A, one live demo of using the prompt-pack, sign-up CTA that auto-grants credits upon confirmation. who can run the demo? @Sara or @Michelle?
Sara: I can run the demo. Michelle will handle copy and slide deck.
Vlad: timeline for rollout: QA on staging gating modal tomorrow, soft launch Thursday morning to 5% of new orgs, ramp to 25% Saturday, full roll by Monday if no regressions.
Mateo: can we include an opt-in for the follow-up product survey? short 2 Qs to measure perceived utility.
Jen: also add an attribution tag for the webinar invite so we can split metrics by invite cohort. `invite_cohort:webinar-1`
OpsBot: QA checklist created: tracking, hubspot mapping, credit grant job, modal content. Ping me when staging PR is ready.
Sara: awesome. last ask — set a simple benchmark narrative in the dashboard: baseline day-7 retention and avg tokens/use for the cohort. if day-7 retention > baseline by 15% -> promote globally.
Michelle: saving that as a tracking card. I'll drop the slide outline here later. :memo:
Sara: perfect. thanks team — will post PR links when drafts are up. :rocket:
